calls.title: Puspita Rini Simamora and Jake Heier
calls.summary: The call discussed GrowthBook, a feature flag and experimentation platform, for self-hosted deployment on AWS. Key pain points included the need for an additional local partner reference beyond SALT, sizing questions (minimum 2GB memory, 1 vCPU, and whether three worker nodes are mandatory), and architectural guidance on CDN vs proxy, persistent storage, and S3 bucket usage. Key participants were Puspita Simamora, her manager Rendhika, and colleague Dede (system integrator), along with Jake Heier (GrowthBook sales)
